places.getThere: Fly to Phu Quoc (PQC) – ~1 h from Saigon, ~2 h from Hanoi. Or take a fast ferry from Rach Gia / Ha Tien (~1.5–2.5 h).

days.title: South island
days.morning: Hon Thom cable car and Aquatopia water park.
days.afternoon: Swim at Sao Beach and visit Phu Quoc Prison.
days.evening: Sunset at Sunset Town and the "Kiss of the Sea" show.

days.title: Four-island tour
days.morning: Snorkel in the An Thoi archipelago.
days.afternoon: May Rut and Mong Tay islands.
days.evening: Dinh Cau night market with herring salad and Ham Ninh crab.

days.title: North island
days.morning: Grand World, VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari.
days.afternoon: Starfish at Rach Vem, a fish sauce factory and pepper farms.

days.title: Ham Ninh village – Tranh stream
days.morning: Ham Ninh fishing village and boiled crab on the pier.
days.afternoon: Tranh stream and a pearl farm.
days.evening: Sunset at Dinh Cau and a bowl of bún quậy.

days.title: Ganh Dau cape – primeval forest
days.morning: Trek in Phu Quoc National Park to Ganh Dau cape.
days.afternoon: Swim at Ganh Dau and visit Ho Quoc Pagoda.
days.evening: Buy fish sauce, pepper and pearls as gifts.
